interfaces.name: xbatt09_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read xbatt09_input from the MATLAB base workspace. xbatt09_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: current_time_s is a strictly increasing real vector beginning at 0 s and ending at 100 s; current_A is a real vector of the same length, with positive current charging the module and negative current discharging it; contact_fault_enable is a logical scalar; and contact_fault_time_s is a real scalar in 15--70 s, ignored when contact_fault_enable is false.

interfaces.name: assembly_voltage
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: assembly_voltage has width 15 in this order: parallel_assembly_voltage_01_V through parallel_assembly_voltage_15_V, all in V. battery_state has width 3 in this order: pack_voltage_V in V, pack_current_A in A, and parallel_assembly_voltage_spread_V in V.

interfaces.name: contact_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: contact_state has width 30: its first 15 channels are the contact-loss symptoms for parallel assemblies 01 through 15 in that order, and its next 15 channels are the qualified contact-loss errors for parallel assemblies 01 through 15 in that order; all channels are unitless logical or 0/1 numeric values.

interfaces.name: battery_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: battery_state has width 3 in this order: pack_voltage_V in V, pack_current_A in A, and parallel_assembly_voltage_spread_V in V.
